description: Deep single-case evidence module covering Abraham Lincoln's rhetoric (1838-1865): a multi-tier annotated corpus (core, validation, reference sets), stage-by-stage annotation artifacts, and methodology documentation.
maintainerNotes: Lincoln's own writings (1838-1865) are public domain; third-party commentary and translations require rights review before import (see docs/architecture/imported-projects.md). LMA Stage 4M multi-model reliability artifacts are reference-only design/status records as of PPW #300; no validated external model submissions exist, and PPW #303 is the execution follow-up. Reliability status remains pending until reviewed submissions or human reliability work pass explicit gates.
